item.title: [ZEPPELIN-1578] Customize Apache Zeppelin homepage > Show notebook list > Notebook corrupted.
item.description:
Customizing the Zeppelin Homepage to show the notebook list does not work as documented here http://zeppelin.apache.org/docs/0.6.2/manual/notebookashomepage.html#show-notebooks-list-in-your-custom-homepage

When creating a new notebook with the code mentioned in the link. The paragraph can be executed once. Any subsequent call will fail, and also the whole notebook gets erroneous.

Looking at the browser console the following error gets logged:

TypeError: Cannot read property 'name' of undefined
    at C (scripts.6ddd912ca4c10818.js:1)
    at scripts.6ddd912ca4c10818.js:1
    at n.$broadcast (vendor.f686b78964de6852.js:38)
    at n.<anonymous> (scripts.6ddd912ca4c10818.js:3)
    at b (vendor.f686b78964de6852.js:75)
    at n._onMessageHandler (vendor.f686b78964de6852.js:75)
    at bound WrappedWebSocket.<anonymous> (vendor.f686b78964de6852.js:36)

comments.comment:
I tested this issue and I faced same error.
In my opinion, the reason is that the following sentence seems to be called twice.

<div class="col-md-4" ng-controller="HomeCtrl as home">

Could you check your customized homepage except the above sentence?
And, please let me know whether it is working well or not

when removing it, no error occurs. but also the notebook list is NOT rendered.

whats also weird is, that when setting this notebook as ZEPPELIN_NOTEBOOK_HOMESCREEN, the Code is rendered on the HOME screen. also after switching the notebook to the report view.

see screen attached.

so the customization of the homescreen is still not working as documented.

Thanks for sharing this issue and letting me know.
please let me check and test again.

Sorry for my late response.
I checked this problem on Zeppelin-0.6.2 and 0.7.0. I think it is a bug.
I will create a regarding PR, after I will fix this problem in Zeppelin-0.7.0 version.

GitHub user soralee opened a pull request:

https://github.com/apache/zeppelin/pull/1804

ZEPPELIN-1578 notes list in customizing zeppelin homepage isn't working

      1. What is this PR for?
        Customizing the Zeppelin Homepage to show the notebook list does not work as [0.6.2 document](http://zeppelin.apache.org/docs/0.6.2/manuala/notebookashomepage.html#show-notebooks-list-in-your-custom-homepage). Furthermore, it is not working on 0.7.0 version ([0.7.0 document](http://zeppelin.apache.org/docs/0.7.0-SNAPSHOT/manual/notebookashomepage.html#show-notes-list-in-your-custom-homepage)).

That reason is that get_home message of zeppelin websocket is called in zeppelin-web twice.

At this chance, I suggest to split role to HomeCtrl and CustomHomeCtrl. because when "Home.controller.js" is update, It could be conflicted like current issue.
So I think it would be more convenient to manage the roles separately.
